**Finding submitted — deviation (IP).**

- **Issue:** Section 11.1.1.4 (p0663) makes SFJ the sole and exclusive owner of the Trial Data Package, which by definition (p0227) captures *all* Information generated by or on behalf of either Party in the Clinical Trials, including the Clinical Trial Database and Research Results — i.e. PB's own trial data and work product. PB only recovers ownership by paying the Approval Payments plus a further purchase price, and the Article 14 assignment (p0783) is expressly effective only "in accordance with Section 11.1.1.4". No interim licence exists, so the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables) fails.
- **Favourable terms left alone:** mutual retention of pre-existing IP (p0650), PB ownership of Trial Inventions (p0659) and Background Materials (p0267), and the no-implied-licence limit on SFJ's use of PB IP (p0666).
- **Cure:** one insert after p0663 granting PB a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to use and modify the Trial Data Package and Research Results for its business — leaving SFJ's ownership and the purchase mechanic (and its many Article 6/14 cross-references) intact, rather than reversing ownership at the preferred level.
